## Details

<a id="Q-001"></a>
### Q-001

Which policy rules can a request violate and still be submitted (exceeding the entitlement, missing a required document, not eligible for the leave type)? Is the date window (future, or past within the current month) a hard block or also a reviewable violation?

**Reason:** The URS allows policy-violating requests but does not say which rules are soft and which are hard.

**Impact if unanswered:** Validation for submitting a request cannot be specified; blocking and flagging behaviour would be guessed.

**Related:**

- [BR-002](../../overview/business-rules.view.md#BR-002) Exceeding the entitlement is reviewed, not blocked
- [BR-001](../../overview/business-rules.view.md#BR-001) Leave date window
- [UC-001](../../overview/use-cases.view.md#UC-001) Submit leave request

**Answer:** Exceeding the entitlement can still be submitted. The date window is a hard block. A missing required document and a leave type the employee is not eligible for also block submission.

**Answer source:** BA (vietngo), GATE-02 review, 2026-09-30

<a id="Q-002"></a>
### Q-002

What happens to a request that is not confirmed or approved by the end of the month of the leave start date? May a request for a later month be reviewed before that month starts?

**Reason:** The URS sets the deadline but not the consequence of missing it, and 'within the same month' can be read as a window or as a deadline.

**Impact if unanswered:** Request lifecycle, reviewer dashboards and notifications stay incomplete.

**Related:**

- [BR-008](../../overview/business-rules.view.md#BR-008) Review deadline and automatic cancellation
- [ENT-006](../../overview/data-model/entities.view.md#ENT-006) Leave Request
- [UC-004](../../overview/use-cases.view.md#UC-004) Confirm or deny leave request
- [UC-005](../../overview/use-cases.view.md#UC-005) Approve or reject leave request

**Answer:** A request that is not confirmed or approved by the end of the month of the leave start date is cancelled. A request for a later month can be reviewed at the end of that month; it does not need to be reviewed before that month starts.

**Answer source:** BA (vietngo), GATE-02 review, 2026-09-30

<a id="Q-003"></a>
### Q-003 — Who confirms a request from an employee who belongs to no project?

**Reason:** The employee selects the confirming Project Manager among those of their own projects; an employee without a project has none to select.

**Impact if unanswered:** Such an employee could not submit a leave request.

**Related:**

- [ENT-003](../../overview/data-model/entities.view.md#ENT-003) Project
- [BR-006](../../overview/business-rules.view.md#BR-006) Two-step review
- [UC-001](../../overview/use-cases.view.md#UC-001) Submit leave request
- [UC-004](../../overview/use-cases.view.md#UC-004) Confirm or deny leave request
- [BR-015](../../overview/business-rules.view.md#BR-015) Employee selects the confirming Project Manager
- [BR-021](../../overview/business-rules.view.md#BR-021) No confirmation for an employee without a project

**Answer:** The employee selects which Project Manager confirms their request, among the Project Managers of the projects they belong to. For an employee who belongs to no project, the Line Manager is the only approver and no confirmation is needed.

**Answer source:** BA (vietngo), 2026-09-30

<a id="Q-004"></a>
### Q-004

Where do employees, the organisational structure, project teams, line-manager assignments and role assignments come from: an existing HR system, an import, or maintenance inside this system? How do country/city/office relate to unit/department?

**Reason:** The URS needs this data but names no source and no use case to maintain it.

**Impact if unanswered:** The data model ownership is unclear and use cases for maintaining this data may be missing.

**Related:**

- [ENT-002](../../overview/data-model/entities.view.md#ENT-002) Employee
- [ENT-001](../../overview/data-model/entities.view.md#ENT-001) Organisational Unit
- [ENT-003](../../overview/data-model/entities.view.md#ENT-003) Project
- [REQ-012](../requirements.view.md#REQ-012) Multinational organisational structure

**Answer:** All of this data comes from an existing HR system.

**Answer source:** BA (vietngo), GATE-02 review, 2026-09-30

<a id="Q-005"></a>
### Q-005

How do users sign in: the company's single sign-on / identity provider, or accounts managed by this system?

**Reason:** The URS only requires secure login and logout.

**Impact if unanswered:** Security rules and any sign-in use case cannot be defined; it also decides whether account management is in scope.

**Related:**

- [REQ-015](../requirements.view.md#REQ-015) Secure login and logout

**Answer:** Users sign in with the company's single sign-on.

**Answer source:** BA (vietngo), GATE-02 review, 2026-09-30

<a id="Q-006"></a>
### Q-006

For the entitlement import: what is the file format, and what does the annual refresh do to unused entitlement and to requests still pending? Does the system calculate seniority-based entitlement, or is it only imported? Do the rules differ per country?

**Reason:** The URS says entitlements are imported yearly and vary by seniority, gender and government regulations, without details.

**Impact if unanswered:** The import use case and the entitlement check on submission cannot be specified.

**Related:**

- [UC-006](../../overview/use-cases.view.md#UC-006) Refresh annual leave entitlements
- [BR-012](../../overview/business-rules.view.md#BR-012) Annual entitlement refresh
- [BR-003](../../overview/business-rules.view.md#BR-003) Seniority-based entitlement
- [ENT-005](../../overview/data-model/entities.view.md#ENT-005) Leave Entitlement

**Answer:** No entitlement amounts are imported: the system calculates every entitlement from the leave type rules, so the yearly import is not needed. After the annual refresh, the new entitlements are the baseline for requests still pending. The rules do not differ per country.

**Answer source:** BA (vietngo), GATE-02 review, 2026-09-30

<a id="Q-007"></a>
### Q-007

Which days count as working days when leave is counted and when the weekly notification determines absences: do weekends and public holidays (which differ per country) count?

**Reason:** Leave is counted in half days, but the working-day calendar is not defined.

**Impact if unanswered:** The entitlement check and the weekly notification would be wrong around weekends and public holidays.

**Related:**

- [ENT-006](../../overview/data-model/entities.view.md#ENT-006) Leave Request
- [ENT-005](../../overview/data-model/entities.view.md#ENT-005) Leave Entitlement
- [UC-001](../../overview/use-cases.view.md#UC-001) Submit leave request
- [UC-008](../../overview/use-cases.view.md#UC-008) Send weekly attendance notification
- [BR-010](../../overview/business-rules.view.md#BR-010) Off-work day definition
- [BR-022](../../overview/business-rules.view.md#BR-022) Working days

**Answer:** Leave is counted in half days, with three options: All day, Morning, Afternoon. Weekends and public holidays are not counted as working days.

**Answer source:** BA (vietngo), 2026-09-30

<a id="Q-008"></a>
### Q-008

Can an employee cancel or withdraw a request, and in which statuses (pending, approved)?

**Reason:** The URS covers only submission, review and resubmission.

**Impact if unanswered:** The request lifecycle may miss a state and a use case.

**Related:**

- [ENT-006](../../overview/data-model/entities.view.md#ENT-006) Leave Request
- [BP-001](../../overview/business-processes.view.md#BP-001) Leave request and approval

**Answer:** An employee can cancel a leave request as long as the Line Manager has not approved it yet.

**Answer source:** BA (vietngo), GATE-02 review, 2026-09-30

<a id="Q-009"></a>
### Q-009

Who approves a Line Manager's own request, and what happens when the Project Manager and the Line Manager of a request are the same person?

**Reason:** The URS defines auto-confirmation only for Project Managers' own requests.

**Impact if unanswered:** A reviewer could end up deciding on their own request.

**Related:**

- [BR-007](../../overview/business-rules.view.md#BR-007) Project Manager self-request is auto-confirmed
- [BR-006](../../overview/business-rules.view.md#BR-006) Two-step review
- [UC-005](../../overview/use-cases.view.md#UC-005) Approve or reject leave request

**Answer:** A Line Manager does not have to submit leave requests. A Line Manager manages the Business Unit, not a project, so they can never be a Project Manager.

**Answer source:** BA (vietngo), GATE-02 review, 2026-09-30

<a id="Q-010"></a>
### Q-010

Are Admin and HR one role or two? Which managers see reports (Project Managers, Line Managers, both), and is what they see limited to their own unit, office or country?

**Reason:** The URS uses 'Admin', 'HR', 'Admin/HR' and 'Managers' without defining them precisely.

**Impact if unanswered:** Permissions for leave type management, import and reporting cannot be finalised.

**Related:**

- [ACT-004](../../overview/actors.view.md#ACT-004) Admin/HR
- [UC-009](../../overview/use-cases.view.md#UC-009) View leave reports
- [BR-014](../../overview/business-rules.view.md#BR-014) Access by role and organisation

**Answer:** Admin and HR are one role. A manager can only see reports for their own unit.

**Answer source:** BA (vietngo), GATE-02 review, 2026-09-30

<a id="Q-011"></a>
### Q-011

For the weekly notification: which period does it cover, which days are working days (weekends, public holidays per country), and does a 'valid leave request' mean approved only or any submitted request?

**Reason:** The URS gives the schedule and the off-work definition only.

**Impact if unanswered:** The notification content would be wrong for some employees.

**Related:**

- [UC-008](../../overview/use-cases.view.md#UC-008) Send weekly attendance notification
- [BR-011](../../overview/business-rules.view.md#BR-011) Weekly attendance notification
- [BR-010](../../overview/business-rules.view.md#BR-010) Off-work day definition

**Answer:** The period is the last week. A valid leave request means any submitted request.

**Answer source:** BA (vietngo), GATE-02 review, 2026-09-30

How is card scanner data made available by the external system (API, file, database), how often, and which identifier links a scanner record to an employee?

<a id="Q-013"></a>
### Q-013

Which mail service is used? What must be configurable in the notification emails, and by whom? Are emails also sent when a request is cancelled, by the employee or automatically?

**Reason:** The email events for submission and decisions are defined; the mail service is not, and the URS asks for configurable emails without detail.

**Impact if unanswered:** The email integration cannot be designed and cancellation would send no email.

**Related:**

- [INT-002](../../overview/integrations.view.md#INT-002) Notification email delivery
- [REQ-016](../requirements.view.md#REQ-016) Automated, configurable notification emails
- [BR-018](../../overview/business-rules.view.md#BR-018) Workflow email notifications
- [UC-010](../../overview/use-cases.view.md#UC-010) Cancel leave request
- [UC-011](../../overview/use-cases.view.md#UC-011) Cancel unreviewed leave requests at month end

**Answer:** The mail service is not defined yet. Submission sends an email to the Project Manager; confirmation sends one to the Line Manager; denial, approval and rejection send one to the employee who submitted the request.

**Answer source:** BA (vietngo), GATE-02 review, 2026-09-30

<a id="Q-015"></a>
### Q-015

How is HR system data made available (API, file, database), and how often can it be fetched?

**Reason:** The HR system is the source of employees, organisation, project teams, roles and public holidays, but no interface is defined.

**Impact if unanswered:** The HR integration and the services that depend on employee data cannot be designed.

**Related:**

- [INT-003](../../overview/integrations.view.md#INT-003) HR system master data

<a id="Q-016"></a>
### Q-016 — How does an employee who joins during the year get a leave entitlement?

**Reason:** Entitlements are calculated at the automatic refresh at the start of the year and do not change during the year; a new joiner has none until the next refresh.

**Impact if unanswered:** An employee who joins during the year would have no entitlement until the next refresh.

**Related:**

- [UC-006](../../overview/use-cases.view.md#UC-006) Refresh annual leave entitlements
- [BR-012](../../overview/business-rules.view.md#BR-012) Annual entitlement refresh
- [ENT-005](../../overview/data-model/entities.view.md#ENT-005) Leave Entitlement

**Answer:** The annual refresh starts automatically at the start of the year. An entitlement does not change when seniority changes during the year.

**Answer source:** BA (vietngo), 2026-09-30

**Remaining:** Not answered yet: employees who join during the year.

**Answer source:** BA (vietngo), 2026-09-30

When does a change to a leave type take effect? (a) Does changing the base days or the years of service per extra day recalculate the entitlements of the current year, or apply from the next annual refresh? <a id="Q-022"></a>
### Q-022

Which limits apply to a leave type? Must the name be unique, and how long can it be? Which range can the base days take: can it be 0 or a half day, and is there a maximum? Does a leave type such as Unpaid Leave have no entitlement limit at all? Which range can N (years of service per extra day) take?

**Reason:** ENT-004 lists the attributes of a leave type but gives no limits, and every leave type has base days although some suggested types may have no yearly limit.

**Impact if unanswered:** The validations of the leave type form cannot be finalised. A leave type without a limit would have to be given 0 base days, so every request of that type would be flagged as exceeding the entitlement (BR-002).

<a id="Q-023"></a>
### Q-023

Which gender values does the HR system provide for an employee, and which eligibility options must a leave type offer: all employees, female only, male only, or others?

**Reason:** ENT-004.gender_eligibility and ENT-002.gender are enums without defined values. BR-004 names only Maternity Leave for female employees.

**Impact if unanswered:** The options of the eligibility field on the leave type form (UC-007) and the eligibility check on submission (UC-001) cannot be finalised.

<a id="Q-024"></a>
### Q-024

Does a reviewer give a reason when denying or rejecting a leave request: mandatory, optional or not at all? May a reviewer add a comment when confirming or approving? Who sees the reason or comment: the employee, the next reviewer, the notification email?

**Reason:** The Review Decision (ENT-008) holds no reason or comment, but an employee is expected to modify and resubmit a request after a denial or rejection (BR-009) and would need to know what to change.

**Impact if unanswered:** The deny and reject dialogs, the Review Decision data and the denial and rejection emails cannot be finalised. Without a reason an employee does not know what to change before resubmitting.

<a id="Q-025"></a>
### Q-025

On the reviewer dashboards, does the request type filter mean the leave type? Does the date filter apply to the leave dates or to the date the request was submitted?

**Reason:** URS §4.7 lists filters for request type, employee name, date and request status without saying what a request type is or which date is meant. A leave request holds a leave type, the leave dates and a submission date.

**Impact if unanswered:** The dashboard filters of the Project Manager and the Line Manager could filter on the wrong attribute.

**Related:**

<a id="Q-026"></a>
### Q-026

How does the day part apply to a request that spans several days? Can Morning or Afternoon be chosen only for a single day, does it apply to every day of the range, or can the first and the last day each have their own day part (for example from Monday afternoon to Wednesday morning)?

**Reason:** A leave request holds one day part (ENT-006.day_part) and its description leaves the multi-day case to the use case specification. No rule says which combinations an employee may request.

**Impact if unanswered:** The request form, the count of days requested and the entitlement check cannot be finalised. If the first and last day need their own day part, the leave request needs a second day part attribute.

<a id="Q-027"></a>
### Q-027

When the system checks whether a request exceeds the entitlement, which of the employee's other requests of the same leave type count as already used: approved requests only, or also requests pending confirmation or approval? Against which year's entitlement is a request counted when its dates span two years?

**Reason:** BR-002 flags a request that exceeds the entitlement, and an entitlement is an amount per leave type and year (ENT-005), but no rule says what is deducted from it.

**Impact if unanswered:** The remaining balance shown on the request form and the Exceeds entitlement flag would be guessed, so requests could be flagged or not flagged wrongly.

<a id="Q-028"></a>
### Q-028

Can an employee submit a leave request whose dates overlap another of their own requests that is pending or approved? If not, is it blocked, or accepted and flagged for review?

**Reason:** The blocking rules are the date window, a missing required document and an ineligible leave type (BR-001, BR-005, BR-004). Overlapping requests are not mentioned.

**Impact if unanswered:** An employee could request the same day twice, the same leave would be counted twice against the entitlement, and reviewers would see duplicates.

<a id="Q-029"></a>
### Q-029

How many files can an employee upload for one required document: exactly one, or several (for example a certificate photographed page by page)? Can an employee attach a document when the leave type requires none?

**Reason:** BR-005 says a leave type may require documents and a supporting document records which required document it satisfies (ENT-007.document_type), but not how many files are allowed or whether optional documents exist.

**Impact if unanswered:** The upload fields of the request form and the missing-document check cannot be finalised.

<a id="Q-030"></a>
### Q-030

When an employee opens one of their own leave requests read-only, do they see the supporting documents uploaded with it and can they download them?

**Reason:** UC-002 reads the leave request, its review decisions and the leave type (ENT-006, ENT-008, ENT-004) but not the supporting documents (ENT-007). The security rules allow an employee to access their own documents, and the reviewer sees them when reviewing the request.

**Impact if unanswered:** The request details screen of UC-002 shows no documents, so an employee cannot check what they uploaded without starting to modify the request. Showing them adds ENT-007 to the entities UC-002 reads, which is a change to the use case in the overview.

- [BR-005](../../overview/business-rules.view.md#BR-005) Required documentation per leave type

<a id="Q-031"></a>
### Q-031

When an employee requests leave that starts in the next year before the annual refresh has run, no entitlement exists yet for that year. Is such a request checked against an entitlement at all: flagged as exceeding (as if the entitlement were 0 days), checked against an estimated entitlement for the next year, or not checked until the refresh?

**Reason:** BR-001 allows any future date, the entitlement is an amount per leave type and year (ENT-005) and entitlements are calculated at the annual refresh at the start of the year (BR-012). The approved functional UI of UC-001 shows "No entitlement on record" and counts 0 days when no entitlement exists, so every request for the next year is flagged as Exceeds entitlement. The UC-001 prototype shows this for a start date in January of the next year.

**Impact if unanswered:** Every request for the next year that is submitted before the refresh would be flagged for manual review (BR-002) and the employee would be warned that it exceeds the entitlement, although it may be within next year's entitlement.
